mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) and falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a potential stagflation scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of decreasing Industrial Production (INDPRO) and increasing Real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a supply-side bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases and GDPC1 increases.
